value.name: Daniel denies taking anything
value.description: Daniel answers bluntly that he has not taken anything from the house.

value.name: Asha asks Lucia the same question
value.description: Asha repeats the accusation to Lucia, pressing her for the same answer in front of the others.

value.name: Lucia hesitates before answering
value.description: Lucia pauses and weighs her response before speaking, revealing her internal conflict.
evidence: She hesitated for perhaps two seconds, which was not long in absolute terms but was very long in the terms of the front hall of that house at that moment

value.name: Lucia denies removing anything
value.description: Lucia states that she has not taken anything out of the house.
evidence: "I have not taken anything out of this house," Lucia said.

value.name: Lucia reveals finding a hidden letter
value.description: Lucia admits she found a letter hidden in the sewing room after the funeral.
evidence: "I found a letter. In the sewing room. The day after the funeral. It was not in the desk. It was — it was tucked into the pincushion. The big velvet one she kept on the machine."

value.name: Lucia keeps the letter in her bag upstairs
value.description: Lucia explains that she did not remove the letter from the house and that it is currently in her bag upstairs.
evidence: "I did not take it out of the house. It is in the house. It is in my bag upstairs."

value.name: Daniel reacts in confusion
value.description: Daniel responds in shock and confusion to Lucia's revelation about the letter.

value.name: Lucia withholds eye contact from Daniel
value.description: Lucia avoids looking at Daniel and continues addressing Asha instead, signaling tension between them.
evidence: Lucia did not look at him. She kept looking at Asha.

value.name: Lucia identifies the letter as a personal message
value.description: Lucia explains that the letter is from her mother and is addressed to her, her brother, and Rosa.
evidence: "It is — it is not the will. It is not a codicil. It is a letter from my mother. It is addressed to me and to my brother and to Rosa."

value.name: Lucia admits rereading the letter nightly
value.description: Lucia confesses that she has read the letter repeatedly since finding it and has been unsure whether to turn it over.
evidence: "I read it the night I found it and I have read it again every night since and I did not know whether to give it to you because I did not know whether you would think it was evidence of something or ju
value.time_hint: the night I found it / every night since
